Container.Name: the-desk
Container.Overview: The Desk — the morning order-sizing worksheet. Sizes each recurring buy from where a position's 30-day average sits in its 52-week range (top third 1x, middle 2x, bottom third 3x of a per-position daily base), and shows accounts, a taxable-lot LTCG exit ladder, the Monte Carlo trend against the retirement band, and the rules registry. Every displayed number traces to the live payload plus a rule id; the tool never decides — all orders are hand-placed. LIVE ONLY: every page load reads Tape and nothing is cached, so when Tape is down there is no worksheet rather than a stale one. Requires TAPE_BASE_URL plus either TAPE_CLIENT_ID/TAPE_CLIENT_SECRET or the legacy TAPE_API_KEY. NOTE: beyond prices, this needs Tape's /v1/portfolio/* surface, which did not exist as of 2026-08-23 — until it ships the dashboard shows gap panels naming each missing endpoint, and substitutes nothing. Notifications fire on exactly two events — a band tier change and a lot entering the 30-day LTCG window — and only if NTFY_URL is set; every ping is also recorded, so nothing is lost when notifications are off.
Container.Description: The Desk — daily order-sizing worksheet and investment-monitoring dashboard (Flask).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The only persistent volume, holding one file: notifier-state.json (which tier each symbol was last seen at, and which LTCG crossings have already pinged). No portfolio data is ever written here — the dashboard is live-only. Lose it and the next notification pass re-establishes tiers with no TIER change badges and may re-send one LTCG ping; nothing else is affected. REQUIRED - an absolute path on a POOL.

Config.Name: TAPE_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Base URL of the Tape API, e.g. https://tape.example.com (no trailing path). REQUIRED — the dashboard has no other data source and caches nothing. Without it the container still starts and serves a page, but that page reports that Tape is unconfigured and names the variables to set.

Config.Name: TAPE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Tape API client id (X-Client-Id), market-scoped. Register a client dedicated to The Desk via Tape's /v1/admin/clients so it can be rotated or revoked without touching anything else. Set together with TAPE_CLIENT_SECRET.

Config.Name: TAPE_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Tape API client secret (X-Client-Secret). Set together with TAPE_CLIENT_ID.

Config.Name: TAPE_API_KEY
Config.Description: LEGACY shared key (X-API-Key), used only while Tape's client registry flag is off. Prefer TAPE_CLIENT_ID/TAPE_CLIENT_SECRET. Setting both is safe — Tape ignores the key in registry mode, so the same container works either side of the cutover.

Config.Name: NTFY_URL
Config.Description: Full ntfy topic URL, e.g. https://ntfy.example.com/my-topic. Blank = no push notifications; the two events are still recorded and shown under SINCE LAST LOOK. Treat this URL as a secret: anyone holding it can read and publish to the topic.

Config.Name: NTFY_TOKEN
Config.Description: Bearer token for a protected ntfy topic (optional).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone. Drives the notification cron below and the dates written into events. Set it to your own zone or the evening pass will fire at the wrong hour.

Config.Name: DESK_NOTIFY_CRON
Config.Description: When to run the NOTIFICATION pass, as a 5-field cron in the container's TZ. This does NOT feed the dashboard — the page is live and never waits on it. It exists because a tier CHANGE is only visible to something that was awake to see the previous tier. Default 17:30 Mon-Fri, after the close. A missed pass is not chased; the next one picks up whatever moved. USE NAMED DAYS (mon-fri), never numbers: the scheduler counts 0 as Monday, so a crontab-style 1-5 fires Tue-Sat — dropping Monday and adding a day with no close.

Config.Name: DESK_NOTIFY_ON_BOOT
Config.Description: Also run the notification pass at container start. Leave true unless you are debugging; it seeds the tier baseline so the first scheduled pass has something to compare against. It does not affect what the dashboard displays.

Config.Name: DESK_STALE_AMBER_HOURS
Config.Description: rule stale-1: price age at which the banner turns amber (AGING). Sizes are still shown.

Config.Name: DESK_STALE_RED_HOURS
Config.Description: rule stale-1: price age at which the banner turns red (STALE) and every computed buy size is WITHHELD — no verdict from stale data. Must be greater than the amber threshold.

Config.Name: DESK_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: INFO (default) or DEBUG. Credentials are never logged at any level.
